experience.title: A repertoire in service of Kodeskill.
experience.lead: WEG, Legacy and the other roles are not the destination. Each one built repertoire for better results and a better experience for Kodeskill clients.

paragraphs: Architecture: I structured the IT department and consolidated the group’s systems so data and processes lived in one place.
Action: as a B2B contractor, in parallel with Kodeskill, I led end-to-end digitization, AI deployment, and mentoring for managers and teams.
Impact: an estimated R$ 125K per year saved on software licenses, with operational steps digitized.
Architecture: I centralized operations from 48 lines across 4 factories (Bluffton/US, Belém/PA, and two plants in Linhares/ES), with rollout toward Argentina, Algeria, and China.
Action: I built applications and integrations that give management, branches, and headquarters production data without waiting for a manual end-of-day close.
Impact: about R$ 300K per year in estimated gains from process, accuracy, maintenance, and centralized data.
highlights: Expanding to Argentina, Algeria and China

paragraphs: Architecture: I joined the Industry 4.0 team through machine-data collection and visualization.
Action: I contributed applications, automations, and dashboards that replaced scattered controls and manual processes.
Impact: teams gained a more reliable, up-to-date view of production.
Architecture: a freight comparator crossing price tables, destination, weight, volume, cargo type, fees, and commercial terms.
Action: the team could pick the best cost-benefit carrier before contracting.
Impact: more than R$ 1.2 million saved in transportation costs over nine months.

impact.title: Results in real operations.
impact.subtitle: From the factory floor to digital products. Measured operational results, and SaaS with per-company isolation, queues, and AI in production.

cards.title: Smart freight optimization
cards.metricNote: in logistics cost savings over nine months
cards.description: Application built to analyze freight tables, conditions, and transport variables, indicating the best cost-benefit option for each operation.
cards.problem: Freight was contracted without a reliable comparison of tables, destination, weight, volume, and fees.
cards.highlight: Automated comparison pointed to the best cost-benefit option before contracting. Over nine months, savings exceeded R$ 1.2 million.

cards.title: Industrial data centralization
cards.metricNote: in estimated gains from process reduction, production accuracy, and maintenance
cards.description: Applications and integrations that centralized data from 48 production lines across 4 factories in Brazil and the United States, enabling preventive maintenance and freeing management from manual end-of-day data closing. Rollout expanding to Argentina, Algeria, and China.
cards.problem: Data from 48 lines across 4 factories depended on a manual end-of-day close.
cards.highlight: Integrations delivered operations to management, branches, and headquarters, and supported earlier maintenance. Estimated gains of about R$ 300K per year, expanding to Argentina, Algeria, and China.

cards.title: Multi-tenant financial SaaS
cards.metricNote: each company sees only its own data
cards.description: Turborepo and Next.js monorepo, with a hexagonal domain. PostgreSQL on Supabase with Drizzle and row-level security, serverless queues on Upstash QStash, billing on Pagar.me, and a pipeline with Playwright, Vitest, and CodeQL.
cards.problem: Each company needed to see only its own financial data, with no leakage across tenants.
cards.highlight: A modular serverless monolith, hexagonal domain, and row-level security per company.

cards.title: AI content and commercial automation
cards.metricNote: asynchronous generation in place of manual and no-code flows
cards.description: On Framefy and MasterClass, OpenAI and Claude orchestrated with NestJS, Fastify, and CQRS. Messaging on BullMQ, RabbitMQ, Evolution API, and ManyChat, in lean Docker containers.
cards.problem: Content generation and commercial operations depended on manual work and no-code platforms.
cards.highlight: Queues and more than one AI provider replaced the manual flow. MasterClass moved the WhatsApp funnels that ran on n8n into NestJS.
